content:
**Tasty Squirrel Stew** is a consumable item in *Fallout 76*.

A tasty stew made of Squirrel Bits, Tatos, and Boiled Water with some added salt and cooked with wood. It greatly reduces hunger and satisfies a moderate amount of thirst while giving a large bonus to XP earned.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Boiled Water (2) Salt (1) Squirrel Bits (2) Tato (2) Wood (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned from plan/recipe Recipe: Tasty squirrel stew | | Tasty Squirrel Stew (1) | 

- Can be crafted at any Cooking Station with the correct ingredients after learning the Recipe.
- Has a 12.2% chance to be sold by Yasmin Chowdhury.

- Tied with cranberry relish in giving the highest XP bonus effect of all food items, with a base 10% increase on any experience gained for one hour.
- Positively affected by the carnivore mutation, doubling its experience gain effect from 10% to 20%, which can be further increased with the Strange In Numbers perk.
- Due to requiring ingredients either found in small amounts like salt or looted off uncommonly-encountered squirrels, it is relatively harder to gather supplies to make compared to its Herbivore-based counterpart.
